_comment: Observability alert thresholds and routing for au-sme-compliance. Values are declarative — wire into your monitoring provider (UptimeRobot, Better Uptime, Datadog, etc.).

alerts.description: HTTP 5xx rate across all API routes
p95 latency for authenticated read endpoints (GET /reports, GET /awards, GET /account, GET /uploads)
alerts.note: NFR-P1 target is 300ms; 500ms is the paging threshold to allow for brief spikes

alerts.description: Zero uploads reaching status=complete during business hours
alerts.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uploads WHERE status = 'complete' AND uploaded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
alerts.threshold: count = 0 during 09:00-18:00 AEST on business days
alerts.nfr: Business KPI — checks run per day

alerts.description: pgmq job queue backlog — indicates stalled consumer
alerts.threshold: pending jobs > 50 OR any job in pending state > 15 minutes

routing._note: Replace *_ENV_VAR placeholders with actual values in your monitoring provider config. Do not hardcode values here.
